summary: Fees $45 confirmed. Hookups 50/W/S, sites 100->106, showers/dump/laundry/wifi, year-round, phone/email booking now sourced; holiday minimum kept. Note cleaned.
flags: Gate facts: posted $45, holidays $55 (3-night minimum, holiday only). Not found in the Good Sam directory under OH. No gateway within 40 km (Pittsburgh 122 km). Presence: own site with posted rates; phone/email booking. Google Maps 4.7/87.

Long-stay: monthly $425 plus electric, seasonal $2,500-$4,000 (May-Oct) with winter site-leave for $300. Imagery shows both RV areas packed with parked rigs in rows. Share of nightly sites is unpublished; test 2 passes (nightly posted), test 4 cannot be measured from the site. Worth a human look: the site's own reviews speak of 'extended family' and work stays.
PIN 590 m off: 39.8377,-81.1880 is in the open field near the entrance road. The RV rows centre about 39.8324,-81.1874 (the stored evidence was read at 39.8320,-81.1885).
